image_description: A dimly lit interior view of a prison cell block, featuring two tiers of cells facing each other across a central walkway. The walls are distressed concrete or plaster with peeling paint, and metal railings line the upper walkways. A dark corridor extends into the background, ending in a barred gate or door. The architecture is utilitarian and aged.
